name: Organex
description: Organex is a comprehensive maintenance compound for synthetic and hybrid organ systems, delivering a precisely formulated combination of enzymatic precursors, SNT nutrition factors, and anti-degradation compounds that keep artificial organs functioning at specification. Synthetic hearts, lungs, livers, and kidneys all require regular Organex supplementation — without it, synthetic organ efficiency degrades by approximately 3–5% per month, eventually leading to organ failure.
effects: maintenance of synthetic organ performance at design specifications
prevention of SNT degradation within organ structures
sustained enzymatic function in hybrid liver and kidney analogs
preservation of electrochemical signaling in synthetic cardiac tissue
extension of synthetic organ operational lifespan
side_effects: mild digestive disruption as enzymatic compounds interact with gut flora
if used with a fully organic system, mild temporary organ stress
long-term use without monitoring can mask early organ failure symptoms
rare: compound accumulation causing toxicity in patients with compromised hybrid kidneys
cultural_context: Organex is a life drug in the most literal sense — anyone with a synthetic organ dies without it. The tiered pricing model is a source of ongoing political rage: the Lazarus generic is functional but associated with faster organ degradation over years, while the premium formulation demonstrably extends synthetic organ life. Tier 1 residents with synthetic organs are in a permanent financial bind. Organex theft and counterfeiting is a major criminal enterprise on the Shelf. The phrase 'down to my last Organex' means someone is close to the edge of survival.
story_hooks: A counterfeiting operation has flooded the Tier 1-2 market with Organex that looks identical to the real product but contains no active compounds — people with synthetic organs are beginning to degrade and don't know why.
A Lazarus executive with a synthetic heart has been found dead — their Organex was replaced with a compound that accelerated organ failure over six weeks, perfectly mimicking natural degradation.
A Shelf community has organized a collective Organex purchase program — buying bulk and distributing it at cost — and Lazarus is using every legal tool available to shut it down.
